verdict.rationale: This story is about an equity-management or cap-table platform that exposes securities drafting and a board-approval queue. Claude is an AI assistant and model platform, so that is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude itself ships securities issuance or board-approval workflows, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft securities (e.g. option grants) via the platform's programmatic surface and leave them queued for human board approval
